title: Write a Testbench: Counter
constraints: Write a self-checking testbench: top module `tb`, instantiating `counter` as `dut`.
Report a detected bug with `$error(...)` (any output line starting with `ERROR`). Finish with `$finish`.
Your testbench runs against the correct counter (it must stay silent) and against 6 hidden buggy versions (it must report an error on each).
The testbench must finish within 10 s of wall time. Add a watchdog.
hints: Keep a reference model in the testbench (`expected` count) and compare after every clock edge.
Cover the corners: reset value, reset while enabled, counting through 15 → 0, holding with en = 0.
Check that reset is synchronous: change `rst` between clock edges and verify that `count` does not change until the next rising edge.

examples.title: saturating counter
examples.input: your testbench + a counter that sticks at 15

examples.title: enable ignored
examples.input: your testbench + a counter that ignores en
